title: MOC MOD
description: MOCMOD is a parody-filled and surprise-packed Forge mod that injects a wealth of absurd and hilarious content into your world. It introduces a host of custom mobs with unique behaviors, some of which are rideable, powerful new items with often chaotic effe
body:
Welcome to ​**Mocmod**, a Forge mod that injects soul, laughter, and a bit of chaos into Minecraft. If you find the vanilla game a bit too serious and crave unexpected surprises and community-inspired humor, you've come to the right place!

## Key Features

### Parody Mobs & Entities

This mod adds a series of creatures with unique AI and behaviors—they're not just challenges but sources of amusement.

- ​**Rideable Mobs**: Hop on the back of ​**Open Lonely Fish**​ or ​**Hyzemperor**​ and ride them!
  
- ​**Easter Egg Names**: Many mobs feature custom names and designs, filled with community inside jokes.
  
- ​**Custom Drops**: Defeating them may yield special loot.
  

### Powerful Tools & Equipment

Enhance your combat prowess with a new set of gear.

- ​**Aeternium Gear**: A powerful end-game tier of tools and armor with high durability and excellent stats.
  
- ​**Unique Weapons**: Such as the ​**Emperor Sword**, ready to help you tackle new challenges.
  

### "Effectively" Surprising Items

Use these new items with caution—the results can be… "interesting."

- ​**Creeper Simulator**: Experience a real creeper-style explosion. ​**​(Warning: Keep away from prized builds**​
  
- ​**​"Antique" Food**: Eating the ​**Old GM Copper Pot**​ or ​**Guyu Pill**​ will grant you a series of… memorable potion effects.
  
- ​**God Apple**: Provides a full set of powerful buffs, your reliable companion for adventures.
